inventory_authority: docs/stabilization/inventory.json (read only; case IDs and mode applicability preserved)
shared_preconditions: Apply the inventory’s existing build/runtime preconditions. Before each case, record exact loaded extension ID, version, and loaded-from path in chrome://extensions; reload the extension and reopen the tested surface before the first run, then repeat after a second extension reload when the case dimension includes reload. Do not treat that setup reload as the post-reload repetition.

Use an existing account already independently known to be guest, member, or admin as stated by the case. Record visible email and role evidence; never change account roles or include credentials. For authenticated writes, record the active device organization and do not infer it from the account.
Use synthetic disposable values for profile edits and retain a record of original values so they can be restored. Preserve existing inventory status and all global runtime preconditions.

Reachability check: inspect the loaded manifest in chrome://extensions. In local/unpacked WXT builds, the popup entrypoint supplies action.default_popup; opening its extension URL in an ordinary tab is not a toolbar-popup test. In a Chrome Web Store build, wxt.config.ts filters out the popup entrypoint and configures Chrome to open the sidepanel on action click. Options and mic-grant remain separately included extension pages; test options from the extension Details > Extension options link, and test mic-grant through Chat’s microphone permission flow.

Use guest profile as applicable, plus a disposable Chrome profile or known test machine where microphone permission can be reset. Record Chrome site-permission state and whether an input device is connected.
steps: Open Chat and click the microphone control to open the extension mic-grant popup.
Grant path: with permission unset and a working input device, click Allow microphone and accept Chrome’s prompt. Record prompt, page status, popup close timing, and Chat mic state.
Deny path: reset extension-origin microphone permission, repeat and deny the Chrome prompt; record status text and whether retry remains enabled.

No-device path: use a test environment with no available input device and permission allowed, repeat; record visible status. Do not report a scenario as exercised if the environment did not support it.
expected: Grant reports “Granted! Closing…” and closes after roughly 1.5 seconds; denial displays permission-denied recovery guidance and leaves Allow enabled; no device displays no-microphone guidance. Separate outcomes per scenario.
gaps: Inventory bundles three outcomes into one case; it does not specify whether one execution may satisfy it. Do not mark complete until each environment-supported branch has independent evidence.
